svg.title: QPU results: from observations to review
svg.desc: Seven required operations under construction: capture and import preserve observations and their origin; derive binds an installed numerical programme; seal and verify separate shared evidence from domain evaluation; inspect and render present the full record passively. These are source-described responsibilities, not an executed domain workflow or a scientific result.

g.text: ANULUM / SCPN QUANTUM COMPUTING SYSTEMS
QPU results: from observations to review
In progress · source review 2026-10-18 · required domain workflow under construction
A / KEEP THE OBSERVATIONS AND THE COMPUTATION DISTINCT
1 / Capture
Completed-job original bytes
Acquisition and custody facts
Times / calibration / quantities
Producer retains origin duties
2 / Import
Preserve foreign/native originals
Keep field origin and missing data
Normalise the reading view
Counts ≠ probability estimates
3 / Derive
Caller-owned installed programme
Environment + ordered inputs
Units / precision / comparison
Complete output + optional seed
A failed or refused derivation is not a successful numerical result.
Validate earlier raw output before later wrappers; retain actual diagnostics for failure, cancellation or resource refusal.
B / SEAL EVIDENCE AND RECORD THE ACTUAL EVALUATION
4 / Seal — shared and domain roles
Shared runtime: content addressing and canonicalisation
Shared runtime: signing and Common evaluation
Pack: domain comparison and policy conjunction
Original scope and provenance remain attached
5 / Verify — a separate immutable report
Explicit policy, evaluation time and caller trust context
Actual installed types / selected source versions
Preserve the original pack; create a new observation
Historical intervals require genuine event sources
C / PRESENT THE WHOLE RECORD WITHOUT EXECUTING IT
6 / Inspect
Complete claims, reasons, quantities and references
Preserve unavailable states and source meaning
No received-programme execution or eligibility grant
7 / Render
Escape foreign text and retain full scope
Assurance from actual class information
Do not promote a declared validation label
Different decisions need their own evidence.
Numerical agreement · provider assurance · producer authenticity
Physical measurement qualification · current domain eligibility
Shared evidence success alone cannot settle these separate outcomes.
The source README documents developer checks; standalone quantum-result acceptance remains open.
Numbered responsibilities describe the intended workflow, not a qualified runtime or new project connection.
Source reading only · no quantum job, programme execution, sealing or verification run performed
Source-owner content, consumer, scientific and publication review pending
